Trump Discussed Weak Yen Concerns With Japan's Finance Minister

U.S. President Donald Trump expressed concerns about the weak yen during a meeting with Japanese Finance Minister Sanae Takaichi earlier this week in New York. Following the discussion, the yen saw an increase in value. The meeting's details were shared by Japan's finance minister.
